title: Apply to become a regulatory food safety auditor
summary: This page provides information on how to apply to become a regulatory food safety auditor by submitting an application to the NSW Food Authority.
intro: To become a regulatory food safety auditor, you need to submit an application to the NSW Food Authority.
who_can_apply: A Certificate IV in Food Science and Technology or related field course

Completion of the following units: audit a cook chill process, audit manufacturing of ready-to-eat meat products, audit a heat treatment process, and audit bivalve mollusc growing and harvesting processes.
High risk auditor applicants must also complete at least one of the following units.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for approval as a regulatory food safety auditor'
Certified copies of your training qualification and valid units of competency
Evidence of your professional indemnity/public liability insurance policy
Proof of identity as indicated on the form

how_to_steps.text: Complete, print and sign the form.
Submit your application with payment by mail, fax or email, to the details on the form.

more_info.text: A ‘certified copy’ is a photocopy that has been compared with the original and endorsed as a true copy by a Justice of the Peace (JP), or a public officer such as a police officer.
